title: Synthesis and performance of CMC/PAM-based interpenetrating network hydrogels for targeted urea delivery
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18880-18890
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00860G, Paper
Open Access

Ehab S. Gad, Saad Alrashdi, Elsayed M. Elnaggar, Ayman H. Ahmed, Medhat E. Owda
CMC/PAM IPN hydrogels were successfully prepared by free-radical polymerization. FTIR, XRD, TGA, and SEM confirmed. Urea release kinetics establishing the hydrogel as a slow-release fertilizer matrix for agriculture applications.
